Upfront Plus below R160 shows in red. Each claim column shows that claim's number (e.g. "71") with shading when the member has been paid/allocated for it, and is left blank when still owing. "CLAIMED" under a Ref number means that member has already claimed against this fund previously; a crying-face icon next to the name is repeated once per prior claim.

Record payment(s)

Enter a member's REF number and the amount they paid. Their Upfront Plus balance updates on its own. If they were owing on an active claim and this payment covers it, they're automatically marked caught up for that claim.
Paste a list of payments, one per line — Ref number and amount, in any order or format ("097 110", "098,250", "099: R90" all work, including pasting straight from a spreadsheet). Each line credits that member's Upfront Plus balance, and anyone who now has enough to cover a claim's deduction is automatically caught up on that claim — exactly like a single payment, just all at once.

Corrections

Look up a member and correct their record directly — balance, claim status, whatever needs fixing. This overrides whatever the automatic calculations produced. After you save, the member is still re-checked for auto catch-up in case the new balance now covers a claim you didn't touch.
MIKE MVALUME — balance R220
Paste a list of fixes, one per line — Ref number, then a new balance and/or a claim status. This overwrites whatever's currently on file for that member, exactly like a single correction, just many at once. Formats accepted per line: Ref, then any of — a plain number for the new Upfront Plus balance, or 72=allocated / 72=owing (also accepts paid/unpaid, yes/no) for a claim status. Mix and match, separated by spaces or commas.

Example: 097 72=allocated 390 sets Ref 097's balance to R390 and Claim 72 to allocated. 103, 71=owing only changes Ref 103's Claim 71 status and leaves the balance untouched.

Add or replace a member

When a member passes away or defaults and someone else is taking over their slot, use "Replace" — it keeps the same REF number and payment history running under the new name. When it's a brand-new person joining the club, use "Add new member" to give them their own REF.
A new REF number is assigned automatically — the next one after the highest REF currently in the register.

Pay for someone else

Use one member's Upfront Plus balance to cover another member's deduction. The amount moves from the payer's balance to the payee's, then the payee is checked for auto catch-up.

Active claims

Deduction amounts default to R110 unless you type a different amount here. "Apply to all 425" runs the deduction against every member right now: anyone with enough Upfront Plus balance is deducted and marked allocated; anyone short is left owing, without any balance taken from them. After that, any member who later makes a payment or receives a transfer that brings their balance up to the deduction amount is automatically caught up on that claim — no extra click needed.

Export final register

Builds the printable register from the current live data: Ref — Name and Surname — Upfront Plus — one column per active claim, matching the original paper register layout. Each claim column shows that claim's number, shaded when the member has been paid/allocated for it; it's left blank if the member is still owing. Green shading in the Claim 74 column and yellow shading in the Claim 73 column indicate that member is eligible/allocated for that claim. Only the Upfront Plus amount prints in red when below R160 (R160 and above print in black). "CLAIMED" prints in red under a member's Ref number if they've already claimed against this fund previously, and a crying-face icon is added next to their name once for each prior claim.
Leave blank to omit this line from the exported documents entirely.
